notes:
v1.16.0 Release:
- Edge voices (Piseth, Sreymom) say words right by themselves: words Edge keeps saying wrong are found in your saved lines and respelled automatically (e.g. សមមុខ is no longer said សំម៉ាមុខ). Needs the VoxCPM2 install; your own pronunciation list still comes first
- New in Settings > Pronunciation: turn the automatic fixes on or off, see the list, and remove any fix you do not want

Also new since v1.6.0:
- v1.15.0: voices start with their subtitle however far Transcribe drifts, a notice on screen is not read as the subtitles, no double voices
- v1.14.0: one voice per character however Gemini spells them, Remove music from BGM, NVIDIA decoding for exports
- v1.13.0: series survives a power cut or lost Wi-Fi, every subtitle voiced, export colours match the preview
- v1.12.0: one voice per character, faster blur exports, overlays and ads removed
- v1.11.0: VoxCPM2 lines said like the actor, 4x faster lines, better Khmer reading
- v1.10.0: the export matches the editor
- v1.9.0: emotions for imported SRTs and on the voice pill, VoxCPM2 Khmer voice, series export folder
- v1.8.0: VoxCPM2 voice capture and voice groups, Fix Rushed Lines, Khmer pronouns
- v1.7.0: Khmer interface, Join into one video, Gemini model changes
